goal: Stable, playable 30 FPS gameplay with zero visual/graphical bugs or artifacts, fast texture loading, fast shader compilation, low RAM/VRAM footprint, and broad multi-hardware compatibility.
open_discovery_policy: The task list below highlights known high-impact bottlenecks, NOT a closed limit. AI agents are encouraged to analyze crates/xcl/src and propose/implement ANY legitimate optimization, crash fix, texture/shader loading improvement, or visual artifact fix that keeps strict VictoryXCL scope and passes SECURITY-GATE.md + eval-pr.ps1.

target_hardware.gpu: AMD Radeon RX 6600 (8 GB VRAM, RDNA2)

tasks.title: Reduce GetWriteWatch overhead via in-place GPU-view stretch mapping
tasks.problem: xcl.log shows 22,328 ms spent in write-watch scanning and 2,438 ms in lock wait across 32,768 GPU-view textures by 2,048 submits.
tasks.acceptance: Lower write-watch ms and lock wait ms in timed smoke run while maintaining 0 crashes and >= baseline FPS.

tasks.title: Add dead-code and algebraic clean-up passes over translated shaders before DXC
tasks.problem: Large shaders trigger heavy DXC and AMD driver PSO compile spikes (xcl-dxc-* and amdxc64.dll) that dip FPS from 30.0 to 7-15 fps and pressure 16 GB system commit.
tasks.acceptance: Pass all recomp/shader unit tests, reduce emitted DXIL/HLSL size and DXC/driver compile time without changing shader semantics.

tasks.title: Speed up background shader/PSO preparation and disk cache hit rate to eliminate menu/cutscene stalls
tasks.problem: Intro/menu frames can drop to 6.9 fps while cold PSOs compile and stand-in pipelines cause pop-in.
tasks.acceptance: Faster shader prep throughput, higher warm cache hit rate, zero frame stalls or stand-in regressions.

tasks.title: Optimize DirectStorage I/O batching and parallel zlib/BCPack decompression to prevent open-world streaming hitches
tasks.problem: Open-world bursts generate 65,536+ DirectStorage requests and 16,384+ deferred page-list writes, causing CPU/disk contention and FPS dips.
tasks.acceptance: Reduce streaming hitching and CPU overhead on HDD/NVMe without corrupting destinations or leaking memory.

tasks.title: Reduce per-draw allocations and lock contention in descriptor/view binding and command list recording
tasks.problem: High draw-count scenes suffer CPU recording overhead from descriptor lookups, root-constant staging copies, and mutex contention.
tasks.acceptance: Measurable reduction in frame time / higher average FPS with all unit tests passing.

tasks.title: Eliminate command-list resubmit GPU stalls by rotating PC command lists/allocators
tasks.problem: xcl.log logs #256-#512 occurrences of 'a command list is submitted while its previous submit is still on the GPU' causing submit waits up to 2.6 ms.
tasks.acceptance: Reduce or eliminate resubmit waits cleanly without triggering D3D12 debug layer ID 553 or device removal.

tasks.title: Eliminate visual flickering, bright flashes, and NaN/Inf propagation in compute/mesh/post-process passes
tasks.problem: Pixel exports have xcl_nan_guard, but compute UAV/RWTexture stores, sky/reflection buffers, and stand-in swaps can still produce flashes or flicker.
tasks.acceptance: Eliminate NaN/Inf/flash sources without breaking valid HDR rendering; verified with unit/shader tests and live visuals.

tasks.title: Retire replaced buffer/texture copies via GPU fences instead of immediate Drop
tasks.problem: Dropping replaced host resource copies before in-flight GPU command lists complete can cause flickering/artifacts (pattern seen in Belobug/VIctory-Belobug-AMD commit 40b8b9b5).
tasks.acceptance: Retire superseded copies behind queue fences with unit tests proving deferred release until fence completion.

tasks.title: Tighten staging, upload ring, and heap commit reuse to eliminate low-commit thrashing on 16 GB RAM
tasks.problem: xcl.log repeatedly releases idle staging buffers under low commit (< 4 GiB free) during heavy world streaming.
tasks.acceptance: Lower peak commit and reduce staging buffer churn without causing OOM or texture corruption.

tasks.title: Implement ID3D12GraphicsCommandList10::#101, CopyMemoryToMemoryX non-UMA path, and unaligned UAVs
tasks.problem: xcl.log reports [STUB] ID3D12GraphicsCommandList10::#101, skipped CopyMemoryToMemoryX outside UMA, and unaligned placed buffer UAVs binding null views.
tasks.acceptance: Handle slot/copy/UAV edge cases properly with unit tests and 0 regressions.

tasks.title: Support optional ResourceMinLODClamp on placed texture views for 8 GB VRAM GPUs
tasks.problem: Streaming 32,768+ placed textures strains 8 GB VRAM and 16 GB RAM commit; a configurable MinLOD clamp env var reduces memory spikes.
tasks.acceptance: Configurable env flag with unit tests verifying SRV MinLODClamp handling.

tasks.title: Reduce total host RAM and commit footprint across caches, DXC/PSO pools, and staging buffers
tasks.problem: Combined host RAM + commit from UMA coherent windows, DXC/PSO compiler heaps, and shader caches leaves tight headroom on 16 GB systems.
tasks.acceptance: Measurable reduction in peak commit and working set RAM in smoke runs with 0 OOM or regression.

tasks.title: Balance CPU and GPU workloads properly to prevent CPU bottlenecks and GPU starvation
tasks.problem: Background DXC/PSO threads, CPU-side detiling/write-watch, and queue waits can starve either the render CPU thread or the GPU.
tasks.acceptance: Better CPU/GPU utilization balance and higher sustained FPS without increasing frame pacing jitter.

tasks.title: Improve compatibility across diverse GPUs and CPUs (AMD RDNA2/3/4, NVIDIA Wave32, Intel Arc, older CPUs)
tasks.problem: Different user GPUs (Wave32 vs Wave64, varying VRAM sizes, driver PSO behavior) and CPUs lacking console instructions (e.g. Insertq) hit edge cases.
tasks.acceptance: Cleaner fallbacks, Wave32/64 and CPU instruction compatibility, and vendor-safe defaults backed by unit tests.

tasks.title: Discover and fix any other FPS, frame-pacing, texture-loading, shader-compile, RAM/VRAM, or visual-artifact issue in VictoryXCL
tasks.problem: Any genuine bottleneck, texture/shader loading stall, visual glitch, artifact, or stability issue found by inspecting the codebase.
tasks.acceptance: Strictly scoped to VictoryXCL emulation, passes SECURITY-GATE.md, includes unit tests, and shows 0 crashes / 0 regressions in eval-pr.ps1 (points scale with measured impact).
